name: C10-12 alcohols
description: C10-12 alcohols (CAS 85665-26-5 ) are a mid-chain fatty alcohol blend derived from natural or synthetic sources, covering the C10 to C12 carbon range. They function primarily as emulsifiers and solubilizers. Used across personal care, cleaning, and industrial formulations, these alcohols act as carrier solvents. In personal care, they serve as emollients in creams and lotions, improving texture and ingredient compatibility. Household and industrial cleaning products use them as solubilizers to incorporate fragrance oils and actives into aqueous systems. They are essential for maintaining stability in complex chemical mixtures. In plastics and polymer processing, they serve as processing aids and carrier fluids where controlled solvency is required. Their low volatility makes them ideal for high-temperature industrial manufacturing environments. Metalworking and lubricant formulators incorporate them into cutting fluids and emulsifiable oils. This supports stable oil-in-water emulsions under demanding process conditions and heavy mechanical stress. The product is supplied as a clear to slightly hazy liquid, typically in drum and IBC quantities. Both natural-derived oleochemical and synthetic grades are commercially available for various procurement needs. Natural grades are often preferred where bio-based sourcing is a requirement. Technical grade is the standard market offering, though suppliers may provide documentation for cosmetic or detergent-grade applications. These alcohols meet rigorous industrial specifications for purity and performance.
